summary: BioCardia filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing the allowance of a Japanese patent for its Heart3D Fusion Imaging software, which aids in treatment planning and real-time navigation during CardiAMP Cell Therapy procedures. No financial terms, deal structure, or special-situation corporate actions are involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of intellectual property progress. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are mentioned. What to watch: subsequent regulatory milestones or partnership developments; no risk-arb angle exists.
